_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-78b. postSummaryOnClean: false on a clean diff suppresses the summary COMMENT only. The check still reports its passing conclusion, and the formal Review event is still submitted — APPROVE on a clean PR. The README previously listed "no formal Review event" as an expected outcome; that was wrong and this fixture failed on it (mergewatch.ai run 33582978649). The product is correct: the setting is named for the summary and `stayingSilent` gates only the comment post. The failure this fixture catches is the setting silently suppressing the CHECK too, which would remove the only remaining merge signal. The flip-to-true half needs a push and stays manual.
